nodes.label: Styling Siblings Based on Count and Index
Reduce Style Repetition with CSS Functions
Search
nodes.rationale: Runs npx queries for user-visible capabilities; queries should be 2-5 words, generic, omitting framework/app nouns.

nodes.label: Retrieve Best Practices
nodes.rationale: Retrieves full guides at implementation start via `npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest retrieve`; results judged by descriptions.

nodes.label: Verify Guidance Compliance
nodes.rationale: Cross-checks code against retrieved guide before concluding; fallbacks applied without forcing unrequested features.

nodes.label: Disclose Skill Usage
nodes.rationale: Ends the response with a per-guide bullet citing id, non-obvious choice and short verbatim quote.

nodes.label: Modernize an Existing Codebase
nodes.rationale: The 4-step legacy-scan flow applies when broad open-ended modernization is requested.

nodes.label: Using npx / pnpx
nodes.rationale: Prefer pnpx when pnpm is available; allowlist `npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest *`; retry with --offline when offline.

nodes.label: Interpreting Browser Support & Fallbacks
nodes.rationale: Assumes Baseline Widely available is safe without fallbacks unless a custom policy is defined.

nodes.label: Browser Support
nodes.rationale: Default policy: Baseline Widely available is safe to use without fallbacks.

nodes.label: Landmarks
nodes.rationale: Wrap regions in header/nav/main/aside/footer; give nav elements aria-labels; don't overuse landmarks.

nodes.label: Headings
nodes.rationale: Use h1-h6 sequentially; one h1 per page; no skipped levels; no fake headings.

nodes.label: Lists
nodes.rationale: Use ul/ol for repeated contiguous content; screen readers announce counts.

nodes.label: Tables
nodes.rationale: Use table + caption + th scope; no tables for layout.

nodes.label: Skip Links
nodes.rationale: Provide bypass links; target must be programmatically focusable.

nodes.label: Semantic HTML
nodes.rationale: Prefer native elements; correct role/behavior built in.

nodes.label: ARIA Roles and States
nodes.rationale: Match ARIA to behavior; manage toggle states like aria-expanded.

nodes.label: aria-invalid
nodes.rationale: Set aria-invalid=false until :user-invalid matches; Firefox/Safari expose empty required fields as invalid at page load.

nodes.label: aria-hidden
nodes.rationale: Don't hide interactive elements via aria-hidden=true.

nodes.label: Accessible Names and Descriptions
nodes.rationale: Every interactive element needs a name; prefer aria-labelledby over aria-label when a visible label exists.

nodes.label: Naming Mechanisms
nodes.rationale: Native label/caption/legend/figcaption with explicit association.

nodes.label: Choosing the Name
nodes.rationale: Disambiguate controls with different effects by accessible name.

nodes.label: Descriptions
nodes.rationale: Instructions/errors are descriptions via aria-describedby; avoid redundancy.

nodes.label: Visually Hidden Utility
nodes.rationale: Text kept in DOM but visually hidden; focusable content opts out via :focus-within/:active.

nodes.label: Language
nodes.rationale: Declare lang on html; declare changes on containers; don't mismatch values.

nodes.label: Titles
nodes.rationale: Unique front-loaded page titles; update SPA titles on transitions; no empty or duplicate titles.

nodes.label: Iframes
nodes.rationale: Descriptive titles; don't disable iframe scrolling.

nodes.label: Tab Order and Focusability
nodes.rationale: Logical tab order; tabindex=0 only when needed; focus moves on updates.

nodes.label: Keyboard Handlers
nodes.rationale: Enter on keydown, Space on keyup for simulated controls.

nodes.label: Focus Indicators
nodes.rationale: Style :focus-visible; keep native focus indication.

nodes.label: Target Sizes
nodes.rationale: Interactive targets >= 24x24 CSS px (2.5.8); bump on coarse pointers.

nodes.label: Images
nodes.rationale: All img have alt; informative alt; alt="" for decorative.

nodes.label: Inline SVGs
nodes.rationale: role=img for non-decorative; aria-hidden for decorative.

nodes.label: Complex Images and Charts
nodes.rationale: figure/figcaption or aria-describedby; semantic tables as alternatives.

nodes.label: Audio and Video
nodes.rationale: Transcripts for audio/video; WebVTT captions; audio descriptions.

nodes.label: CSS Generated Content
nodes.rationale: Use content() alt-text argument; keep meaningful text in DOM (WCAG F87).

nodes.label: Labels and Hints
nodes.rationale: Mandatory labels; placeholders not persistent labels; hints via aria-describedby.

nodes.label: Input Assistance and Validation
nodes.rationale: Mandatory autocomplete for personal info fields; required signals; no context shifts on focus changes.

nodes.label: Live Regions
nodes.rationale: Announce AT updates not tied to navigation/focus; debounce frequently-changing regions.

nodes.label: Live Region Urgency Table
nodes.rationale: assertive for critical, polite for standard, off for passive.

nodes.label: When to Announce Live Regions
nodes.rationale: Announce dynamic errors; don't use live regions for interstitial states.

nodes.label: Managing Announcements
nodes.rationale: Centralize announcements; coordinate with dialog/inert state changes.

nodes.label: Color
nodes.rationale: See color (via retrieve) for accessible color: contrast, Forced Colors Mode, tints/shades.

nodes.label: Typography
nodes.rationale: See typography guide for readable typography.

nodes.label: Motion
nodes.rationale: See motion guide; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.label: Modals and Native Dialogs
nodes.rationale: Native dialog with showModal() sets outside inert; no manual focus traps needed.

nodes.label: Native dialog
nodes.rationale: Use showModal() for modal state; don't implement focus traps for modal dialogs.

nodes.label: Custom Overlays
nodes.rationale: Use inert for custom overlays; move focus to overlay when opening.

nodes.label: Testing Validations
nodes.rationale: Run axe-core or Lighthouse audits; don't trust a 100% score.

nodes.label: Automated Checks
nodes.rationale: Catch missing alt texts and low contrasts with axe-core/Lighthouse.

nodes.label: Manual Testing
nodes.rationale: Validate sequential navigation with keyboard alone; test on screen readers.

nodes.label: The Problem
nodes.rationale: Standard HTML5 validation shows visual feedback (:invalid/:user-invalid) but doesn't sync aria-invalid; screen readers announce invalid prematurely.

nodes.label: The Solution
nodes.rationale: Sync aria-invalid with :user-invalid; set aria-invalid=false until matched; list error id in aria-describedby while invalid; announce errors via one polite live region; move focus to first invalid field or error summary after failed submit.

nodes.label: Visual Layer
nodes.rationale: CSS :user-invalid controls border/icon visibility; error message display via rules.

nodes.label: Accessibility Layer
nodes.rationale: aria-invalid + aria-describedby communicate state to assistive tech.

nodes.label: Bridge Visual & Accessibility Layer
nodes.rationale: JS listens for blur/change/input/invalid events, checks :user-invalid, updates ARIA attributes.

nodes.label: Focus on Submit
nodes.rationale: After a failed submit move focus to the first invalid field or an error summary (heading + links).

nodes.label: Error Summary
nodes.rationale: Heading followed by links to each invalid field on long forms.

nodes.label: Polite Live Region
nodes.rationale: One polite live region per page announces errors on blur/change, a moment later so it doesn't talk over the next field.

nodes.label: Focus Management
nodes.rationale: Move focus to the first invalid field on failed submit; keep focus on fields receiving it.

nodes.label: UserInvalidFallback
nodes.rationale: Tracks interaction state via WeakMap when :user-invalid unsupported; sets user-invalid-fallback/user-valid-fallback classes and syncs aria-invalid.

nodes.label: data-error
nodes.rationale: Field's data-error attribute holds the error message id, listed in aria-describedby only while invalid.

nodes.label: aria-describedby
nodes.rationale: Text referenced by aria-describedby is announced even when hidden — so the error id must only be listed while the field is invalid.

nodes.label: Accessible Generated Content
nodes.rationale: CSS generated content shouldn't convey meaningful text to AT (WCAG F87); alt-text argument is harm reduction.

nodes.label: Alt Text Argument
nodes.rationale: Use content: url(x) / "Save" style — alt text differs from primary value and isn't already in the DOM.

nodes.label: DON'T Convey Meaningful Text via content()
nodes.rationale: Labels, state, and instructions must stay in the DOM.

nodes.label: Fallback Strategies
nodes.rationale: Older browsers drop declarations without `/` alt-text syntax — provide single-value content fallback.

nodes.label: Respect OS Text Scale
nodes.rationale: Opt in via <meta name="text-scale" content="scale"> so the browser scales root font size to the OS preference.

nodes.label: text-scale meta tag
nodes.rationale: Signals adaptive, safe-to-scale; in <head>.

nodes.label: Relative Typography & Spacing
nodes.rationale: Font sizes in rem/em, unitless line-heights, relative margins/padding; prevents clipping/overlap at scale.

nodes.label: Root Font Size
nodes.rationale: DON'T set font-size on :root/html when opted in — double-scales.

nodes.label: Scalable Responsive Breakpoints
nodes.rationale: Breakpoints must not assume default text size; prefer content-driven layouts and em-based media queries.

nodes.label: Content Wrapping & Flexible Heights
nodes.rationale: Containers must grow around content; avoid fixed/max heights; use min-height.

nodes.label: Language Detector API
nodes.rationale: Client-side web API identifying the language of a given text; enhances privacy, reduces external libs/server calls.

nodes.label: Translation Prep
nodes.rationale: Identify source language before sending text to a translator.

nodes.label: Safety & Filtering
nodes.rationale: Load specific models for tasks like toxicity detection.

nodes.label: Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Label content with the correct lang attribute for screen readers.

nodes.label: UI Localization
nodes.rationale: Adjust app interfaces based on the user's input language.

nodes.label: Hardware & System Requirements
nodes.rationale: Windows 10/11, macOS 13+, Linux, or Chromebook Plus; 22 GB free; 16 GB RAM + 4+ cores; 4 GB+ VRAM.

nodes.label: Model Management & User Activation
nodes.rationale: MANDATORY: LanguageDetector.create() from downloadable/downloading state must be user-initiated (e.g., button click) to prevent NotAllowedError.

nodes.label: Ranked Language Results
nodes.rationale: detector.detect() returns ranked languages with confidence 0.0-1.0; avoid on very short phrases (accuracy drops significantly).

nodes.label: Security and Environment
nodes.rationale: Cross-origin iframes need explicit Permissions Policy; not available in Web Workers; no data sent to Google.

nodes.label: Web Workers
nodes.rationale: Not available due to Permission Policy complexities.

nodes.label: Fallback Strategy
nodes.rationale: Remote API fallback (e.g., Vertex AI Gemini) or graceful degradation.

nodes.label: Prompt API
nodes.rationale: Runs NLP tasks in the browser via Gemini Nano; user privacy, lower server costs, offline.

nodes.label: Gemini Nano
nodes.rationale: The built-in browser AI powering the Prompt API.

nodes.label: User Gesture Requirement
nodes.rationale: When availability() is downloadable/downloading, create() starts the download and needs a user gesture (e.g., button click).

nodes.label: Hardware Requirements
nodes.rationale: 22 GB storage; 16 GB RAM + 4+ cores; 4 GB+ VRAM for audio input; network only for initial download.

nodes.label: Basic and Streamed Output
nodes.rationale: prompt() for short one-shot; promptStreaming() for longer content.

nodes.label: innerHTML Safety
nodes.rationale: MANDATORY: never assign model output to innerHTML; use textContent or a sanitizer.

nodes.label: Polite Live Region
nodes.rationale: Output element is a polite live region; set aria-busy=true while streaming so AT announces the complete response, not chunks.

nodes.label: lang Attribute on Output
nodes.rationale: If output language differs from page language, set lang on the output element (WCAG 3.1.2).

nodes.label: Multimodal Input
nodes.rationale: Prompt API supports text, audio, and visual inputs (canvas, video frames).

nodes.label: Sessions
nodes.rationale: Sessions maintain context across multiple interactions.

nodes.label: Context and Quota
nodes.rationale: Each session has a max token limit; oldest messages except the system prompt are dropped on overflow.

nodes.label: Session Cloning
nodes.rationale: Cloning starts parallel conversations sharing initial context; destroy clones when done.

nodes.label: Restoring Past Sessions
nodes.rationale: Recreate sessions by feeding previous history into initialPrompts.

nodes.label: localStorage History
nodes.rationale: Stored conversation history is unencrypted and persistent; consider privacy before persisting user PII.

nodes.label: Structured Output with JSON Schema
nodes.rationale: Use responseConstraint with a JSON Schema to prevent conversational filler.

nodes.label: Prefix (Assistant Response Prefill)
nodes.rationale: Use prefix: true to prefill the assistant's response.

nodes.label: Resource Cleanup
nodes.rationale: Always call session.destroy() when a conversation is finished to free device memory.

nodes.label: Aborting Tasks
nodes.rationale: Use AbortController; pass signal to prompt()/promptStreaming(); move focus to the start control if hidden while focused (WCAG 2.4.3).

nodes.label: Error Handling
nodes.rationale: create(), prompt(), promptStreaming(), JSON.parse() can all fail — wrap them in try/catch (WCAG 3.3.1).

nodes.label: Permission Policies
nodes.rationale: Use Permission Policies in iframes: <iframe allow="language-model">.

nodes.label: Dos and Don'ts
nodes.rationale: Pre-warm sessions; initial prompts at creation; clone for repetitive tasks; destroy unused sessions; render streaming output as untrusted (Sanitizer API); optimize input for speed; cache results.

nodes.label: Summarizer API
nodes.rationale: On-device text distillation via Summarizer API; supports key-points/tldr/teaser/headline formats; one-time model download.

nodes.label: Type, Format, Length Options
nodes.rationale: type ∈ {key-points, tldr, teaser, headline}; format ∈ {markdown, plain-text}; length ∈ {short, medium, long}; preference ∈ {auto, speed, capability}.

nodes.label: Shared Context
nodes.rationale: sharedContext sets intended audience (e.g., 'This is a scientific article').

nodes.label: Expected Languages
nodes.rationale: Specify expectedInputLanguages/outputLanguage; apply lang to summary container when output language differs (BCP 47).

nodes.label: summarize() and summarizeStreaming()
nodes.rationale: Batch summarize for long text; streaming for responsive UI.

nodes.label: Data Privacy
nodes.rationale: No data is sent to Google; processing is on-device.

nodes.label: Cross-Origin Access
nodes.rationale: Access granted to iframes via Permission Policy: <iframe allow="summarizer">.

nodes.label: Web Workers
nodes.rationale: Not supported.

nodes.label: Fallback Strategy
nodes.rationale: Remote API, graceful degradation, or polyfills (e.g., built-in-ai-task-apis-polyfills) — polyfills proxy to remote services, nullifying on-device privacy.

nodes.label: Mandatory Options Passing
nodes.rationale: Pass the identical options object to Summarizer.availability(options) and Summarizer.create(options); don't use deprecated window.ai.summarizer.

nodes.label: Mandatory Progress Monitoring
nodes.rationale: Provide monitor(m) with a downloadprogress listener to observe model download.

nodes.label: User Gesture Requirement
nodes.rationale: When availability is downloadable/downloading, create() requires a user gesture (e.g., user click).

nodes.label: Translator API
nodes.rationale: Client-side text translation via Chrome/Edge built-in AI (Gemini Nano); reduces cloud costs and improves privacy.

nodes.label: API Surface
nodes.rationale: Access Translator exclusively via the global Translator interface (window.Translator); don't use deprecated window.ai.translator.

nodes.label: Browser Support
nodes.rationale: Chrome 138+ (desktop), Edge 148+ (desktop); not on mobile/Firefox/Safari.

nodes.label: Hardware Requirements
nodes.rationale: Windows 10/11, macOS 13+, Linux, or Chromebook Plus; ≥22 GB storage; 16 GB+ RAM; 4 GB+ VRAM (mandatory for Prompt API with audio).

nodes.label: Availability
nodes.rationale: Statuses: available / downloadable / downloading / unavailable.

nodes.label: Mandatory Options Passing
nodes.rationale: Pass identical sourceLanguage/targetLanguage options to Translator.availability(options) and Translator.create(options).

nodes.label: Recommended Progress Monitoring
nodes.rationale: Provide monitor(m) + downloadprogress listener to show model download progress.

nodes.label: User Gesture Requirement
nodes.rationale: When availability is downloadable/downloading, create() triggers the download — strictly requires a user gesture.

nodes.label: translate() and translateStreaming()
nodes.rationale: translate('Where is the next bus stop, please?') and streaming translateStreaming(longText) for long text.

nodes.label: Supported Languages
nodes.rationale: BCP 47 codes: ar, bg, bn, cs, da, de, el, en, es, fi, fr, hi, hr, hu, id, it, he, ja, kn, ko, lt, mr, nl, no, pl, pt, ro, ru, sk, sl, sv, ta, te, th, tr, uk, vi, zh, zh-Hant.

nodes.label: Accessibility: lang Attribute
nodes.rationale: Apply lang to the container of translated content matching the target language BCP 47 code.

nodes.label: Security & Privacy
nodes.rationale: No data sent to Google servers once model is downloaded; Permission Policy for iframes: <iframe allow="translator">.

nodes.label: Fallback Strategy
nodes.rationale: Remote API, graceful degradation, or polyfills (e.g., prompt-api-polyfill).

nodes.label: Animate to Intrinsic Sizes
nodes.rationale: Animating to dynamic sizes (block-size: auto, inline-size: max-content) historically needed JS or fragile max-height hacks; interpolate-size + calc-size enable native interpolation.

nodes.label: Opt-in to Keyword Interpolation
nodes.rationale: Apply interpolate-size: allow-keywords to a parent (usually :root); transitions to intrinsic keywords disabled by default (numeric-only).

nodes.label: calc-size()
nodes.rationale: Math on intrinsic sizes (e.g., auto + 2rem); supports `any` basis for basis-agnostic calculations.

nodes.label: Generic Expansion Pattern
nodes.rationale: Show More / nav menu pattern: fixed 100px → auto via transition on block-size.

nodes.label: Collapsible Alert
nodes.rationale: Dismissible component: collapse to 0 + pointer-events: none; wait for transition before setting hidden=true so it leaves the AT tree.

nodes.label: Accessibility Synchronization
nodes.rationale: Zero-size collapse hides from AT/tab order; sync aria-expanded on triggers; use getAnimations() to wait for transition completion.

nodes.label: prefers-reduced-motion
nodes.rationale: Disable sizing animations for sensitive users (vestibular disorder).

nodes.label: At-Rule Support Conditionals
nodes.rationale: Use @supports at-rule(@name) for conditional at-rule support; never for detecting the at-rule itself.

nodes.label: Supports selector() Detection
nodes.rationale: Use @supports (color: --foo()) or selector() to detect property/value/selector support before checking the at-rule itself.

nodes.label: Container Query Types
nodes.rationale: at-rule() detects by name only; use container-type values (size, style, scroll-state, anchored); there is no container-type: style — detect style queries with an always-true style query.

nodes.label: Registered Custom Properties (@property)
nodes.rationale: Register a non-inheriting property set to a space on :root for general-purpose detection, or use the @property initial-value trick.

nodes.label: JavaScript Detection
nodes.rationale: Check interface presence (globalThis.CSSFunctionRule) or parse a test stylesheet (CSSStyleSheet.replaceSync) for deeper detection.

nodes.label: JS Does Not Apply Styles Directly
nodes.rationale: Apply a class to the root element and branch in CSS, not styles from JS.

nodes.label: Fallback Strategies
nodes.rationale: Only use @supports at-rule() for at-rules narrower than the feature itself; detect at-rule() with guaranteed at-rules like @supports at-rule(@media).

nodes.label: calc-size()
nodes.rationale: Perform math on intrinsic keywords (auto, min-content, fit-content); MANDATORY fallback with standard keyword/length.

nodes.label: Valid Basis Arguments
nodes.rationale: auto/min-content/max-content/fit-content/content (flex-basis)/any/nested calc-size; fixed length is also valid basis.

nodes.label: size Keyword
nodes.rationale: Only available in the second argument; represents the resolved basis.

nodes.label: Accordion Content
nodes.rationale: Block-size 0 + visibility hidden closed; open: block-size: calc-size(auto, size + 2rem) + visibility visible; include visibility in transition.

nodes.label: Respecting User Motion Preferences
nodes.rationale: Disabling disruptive size animations for vestibular; replace with subtle opacity fade.

nodes.label: Dynamic Container
nodes.rationale: Constrain intrinsic sizes with calc-size(fit-content, min(size + var(--extra-space), var(--max-allowed))).

nodes.label: Percentage Pitfalls
nodes.rationale: Percentages in calc-size resolve against the container's size, not the `size` keyword.

nodes.label: Performance Note
nodes.rationale: Animating size triggers layout recalcs; use calc-size animations primarily for layout-critical elements.

nodes.label: interpolate-size
nodes.rationale: MANDATORY for simple keyword animations (0 to auto); calc-size for math on intrinsic size.

nodes.label: Child State Based Styling
nodes.rationale: Use :has() + state pseudos on descendants to style the parent based on child state (e.g., theme-card reacting to checkbox).

nodes.label: :has()
nodes.rationale: Scope to the most specific container; avoid body:has() — broad :has() queries trigger more layout recalculations.

nodes.label: Theme Card
nodes.rationale: Example: .theme-card switches color variables via .theme-card:has(.theme-toggle:checked).

nodes.label: Performance Tip
nodes.rationale: Scope :has() to specific containers; avoid body:has() for localized changes.

nodes.label: Content Based Styling
nodes.rationale: :has() as parent selector based on presence of descendants; .article-card row layout when image present.

nodes.label: Article Card
nodes.rationale: Example: text-only variant via .article-card:not(:has(img)) gets light background.

nodes.label: Performance Tip
nodes.rationale: Scope :has() to most specific container; avoid body:has() for localized changes.

nodes.label: Layout Modes Decision Tree
nodes.rationale: flexbox (1D rows/cols); grid (2D skeleton); subgrid (ragged edges); multi-column (balanced prose); grid dense; anchor positioning; grid lanes (masonry).

nodes.label: Flexbox
nodes.rationale: One-dimensional; gap; flex shorthand; margin-inline-start: auto; min-inline-size: 0; align-items: safe; no order/reverse for interactive content.

nodes.label: Grid and Subgrid
nodes.rationale: 2D; repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min, 1fr)); subgrid on one axis; no subgrid on both axes with variable children; no grid-auto-flow: dense on interactive content.

nodes.label: Grid Template Areas
nodes.rationale: Self-documenting named regions, aligned in rows/columns.

nodes.label: Container Queries
nodes.rationale: container-type: inline-size/size; container-name; cqi/cqb; definite block-size needed for size type.

nodes.label: Native Overlays
nodes.rationale: popover for transient non-modal; <dialog> + showModal() for modal; don't combine both.

nodes.label: Anchor Positioning
nodes.rationale: position-area + anchor-size; position-try-fallbacks; feature-detect @supports (anchor-name: --x).

nodes.label: Overflow Tracking and Layout Stability
nodes.rationale: overflow: auto; scrollbar-gutter: stable; overscroll-behavior; line-clamp.

nodes.label: Line Clamp
nodes.rationale: Unprefixed line-clamp + -webkit-line-clamp triad for multi-line truncation.

nodes.label: Viewport Mechanics and Track Distribution
nodes.rationale: dvh/dvw; don't use 100vw for full width.

nodes.label: Grid Lanes (Masonry)
nodes.rationale: grid-lanes spec in development; multi-column for document fragments; feature-detect @supports.

nodes.label: Single Line Overflow
nodes.rationale: Truncating text that must stay on one line, revealing full text on demand.

nodes.label: Swipe to Reveal
nodes.rationale: Swipe-to-reveal tracks propagate scroll via overscroll-behavior: chain.

nodes.label: Performance
nodes.rationale: Render performance via content-visibility/containment.

nodes.label: Cascade Layers (@layer)
nodes.rationale: Explicit priority zones declared upfront (reset, base, theme, components, utilities); :where() within layers.

nodes.label: Logical Properties
nodes.rationale: margin-inline-start, padding-block etc.; ask 'would I want this to flip in RTL?'?

nodes.label: Cascade Avoidance
nodes.rationale: Avoid BEM naming; prefer :where() instead of duplicating rules.

nodes.label: Scoping
nodes.rationale: No global resets on *; @scope over :not() for deep subtrees; nesting; @scope when proximity should win.

nodes.label: currentColor
nodes.rationale: Use currentColor instead of variable + color duplication.

nodes.label: inherit Keyword
nodes.rationale: Use inherit instead of parent variable + same-property duplication.

nodes.label: em Units for font-size
nodes.rationale: font-size: var(--size) → use em on the element.

nodes.label: cqw/cqh Units
nodes.rationale: Use cqw/cqh (or cqi/cqb) instead of repeating box model values.

nodes.label: Design Tokens and Theming
nodes.rationale: Tiers: literal → semantic → UI → component; no nontrivial inline values.

nodes.label: Theming
nodes.rationale: Dark mode, Forced Colors Mode, tints/shades, browser-ui-theming.

nodes.label: Transitions & Animations
nodes.rationale: See motion guide; rendering performance via content-visibility.

nodes.label: Generated Content
nodes.rationale: See accessible-generated-content (cites D4).

nodes.label: corner-shape: squircle
nodes.rationale: Progressive enhancement over regular rounded corners.

nodes.label: Elliptical Border Radius
nodes.rationale: Use elliptical border-radius for proportional curves without extra elements.

nodes.label: Design Token Reactivity
nodes.rationale: Container style queries style elements based on ancestor's computed custom property value; decouples markup from presentation.

nodes.label: Container Style Queries
nodes.rationale: @container style(--density: compact/spacious); container itself can't be styled by its query.

nodes.label: Density Tokens
nodes.rationale: --density: spacious/compact set on container; cards inside react via style queries.

nodes.label: Selector Fallback (data-density)
nodes.rationale: data-density attributes + :where() to avoid specificity; nesting limitation with equal specificity.

nodes.label: Feature Checking with CSS
nodes.rationale: --style-queries-supported + @container style(--style-queries-supported) to conditionally show UI.

nodes.label: Feature Checking with JavaScript
nodes.rationale: Check computed style of --style-queries-supported via getComputedStyle.

nodes.label: Dynamic Color Systems
nodes.rationale: Hue via calc(360deg / sibling-count() * sibling-index()).

nodes.label: Symmetrical Layout and Fan Effects
nodes.rationale: --center = calc((sibling-count() + 1) / 2); rotate around center.

nodes.label: Circular and Complex Positioning
nodes.rationale: sin()/cos() with --angle/--radius for perfect circles.

nodes.label: sibling-index() and sibling-count()
nodes.rationale: Feature detection with CSS.supports; --sibling-index/--sibling-count base values overridden by native functions in @supports.

nodes.label: Fluid Scaling
nodes.rationale: Container query units scale internal proportions relative to parent; promotes component isolation/reusability.

nodes.label: container-type: inline-size
nodes.rationale: Width-based scaling; name containers with container-name.

nodes.label: Container Query Units
nodes.rationale: cqi/cqb/cqmin/cqmax; 1% of container inline/block size.

nodes.label: clamp() Constraints
nodes.rationale: Max ≤ 2.5× min for accessibility; don't shrink container when zooming.

nodes.label: Individual Transform Properties
nodes.rationale: translate/rotate/scale apply independently in fixed order (translate → rotate → scale → transform last).

nodes.label: Identity Transformations
nodes.rationale: MANDATORY: apply identity transforms (translate: 0px; rotate: 0deg; scale: 1) on base when state changes may animate them.

nodes.label: Independent Animation and Transitions
nodes.rationale: Overlapping animations on different properties without conflict.

nodes.label: transform Function Order
nodes.rationale: transform applies after individual properties; scale: 2 + transform: scale(3) = 6x.

nodes.label: Overflow Clipping Control
nodes.rationale: overflow: clip + overflow-clip-margin give precise clipping; replaced elements default to overflow: clip + content-box.

nodes.label: overflow-clip-margin
nodes.rationale: Box-edge alignment + offset; child shadows/drop-shadows can bleed without expanding geometry.

nodes.label: Nested Rounded Curves
nodes.rationale: overflow-clip-margin: content-box on rounded parents clips children into concentric radii.

nodes.label: Shadow Bleed
nodes.rationale: Extended clip margin lets child shadows render outside parent; requires clip on block containers.

nodes.label: Fallback Strategies
nodes.rationale: overflow: hidden base; overflow: visible where drop-shadows/badges must not truncate.

nodes.label: Do Not Use clip When Programmatic Scroll Needed
nodes.rationale: clip disables scrolling; don't use with sticky or JS scrolling.

nodes.label: @function at-rule
nodes.rationale: Dashed names, parameters, result, local scoping, type constraints.

nodes.label: Design System Tokens (Gradients)
nodes.rationale: Consistent gradients via @function --fancy-gradient(--start-color, --end-color, --angle).

nodes.label: Conditional Layout Logic
nodes.rationale: @media inside functions; default first, cascade resolves last match.

nodes.label: Best Practices
nodes.rationale: Dashed names; defaults; keep simple; types; precompiler alternative.

nodes.label: Fallback Strategies
nodes.rationale: Declare property fallback first; CSS functions invalid in older browsers.

nodes.label: Responsive Design
nodes.rationale: Container queries for component-driven layouts; dvh/dvw; aspect-ratio for media (CLS).

nodes.label: Responsive Typography
nodes.rationale: clamp() combos; viewport units don't grow on zoom; max 2.5× min; browser zoom to 500% keeps text resizable to 200%.

nodes.label: Selector & @-rule Combinations
nodes.rationale: Combine selectors + media queries + container style queries; decouple filter from applied rules using custom properties on ancestor.

nodes.label: Decoupled Filter
nodes.rationale: Store combined filter result as custom property (e.g., --color-scheme) set by media/:has() rules.

nodes.label: Keyed Rules
nodes.rationale: @container style(--color-scheme: dark) vs not style(...).

nodes.label: Utility Classes
nodes.rationale: Must win over component styles (hence !important); gate with not style(...).

nodes.label: Fallbacks: Critical vs Non-Critical
nodes.rationale: Critical → naive duplication; non-critical → base styles outside @container + overrides.
